name: Lightly Sweetened Maple Berry Blend Cereal
ingredientsText: Almonds, Whole Grain Wheat, Organic Maple Syrup, Whole Grain Oats, Sugar, Dried Coconut, Pumpkin Seeds, Organic Coconut Oil, Dried Sweetened Cranberries (cranberries, sugar, glycerin), Dried Sweetened Cherries (cherries, sugar, glycerin), Corn Bran, Brown Sugar Syrup, Salt, Vanilla Extract. Vitamin E (mixed tocopherols).
notes: Coconut appears in the Contains line but not as 'tree nuts (coconut)'; tree_nut is contains from almonds anyway. The printed line joins the two statements with a semicolon.
